# TPP Product Specification Verification Register

Internal SEO QA, 2026-11-08. Extracted from currently committed catalog pages.

Do not assign category-level dimensions, backing, certifications, performance or country of origin to an individual sample code unless a product-specific, verifiable source confirms it.

## Verified product code equivalence

The website prefix **LEA** and the source Excel prefix **LE** identify the **same genuine-leather products**, per the user's confirmation on 2026-11-08. Example: `LEA2508273` (web) = `LE2508273` (file). All 20 LEA catalog codes match the corresponding LE codes in `tpp spec.xlsx`, sheet `Prod`. This establishes code identity, **not the completeness or unit of each technical field**.

## Required evidence before publishing

1. PU / PU Nubuck: code-specific material composition, backing, thickness with tolerance, usable roll width, intended application, finish/colour, test results (where available), and confirmed MOQ/delivery terms.
2. Genuine leather: code-specific species and grade, finish, thickness, hide/usable area, application, test results (where available), and quotation terms.
3. Cite the document revision and date for every verified value; leave unknown values as pending.
4. Translate only verified facts into EN, VI and ZH. Never invent a certificate.

Category-level synthetic material information already on the site is not proof of any individual sample's specification.
Manual end-to-end Web3Forms delivery test remains unverified; do not send test submissions to a customer's mailbox without consent.
